status: DRAFT - NOT FROZEN (awaiting review by J. Roemer; freeze before 2026-11-01)
scope: v0.3 mass-change / collapse module; does not modify C1, C2, M1-M7, A1-A7, E1

prespecified_data_touched: discriminator thresholds and rule order (from S2)

M8.positives: all ComCat events typed landslide, mine collapse or collapse in the window (labels hidden for classification)

negatives.global_M5: all ComCat earthquakes M>=5.0, depth<=40 km, in the window
negatives.matched_M2_4.5: ComCat earthquakes 2.0<=M<=4.5 from the networks that contributed positives in the same window; random sample of at most 150 per network, numpy default_rng(20271115), without replacement

M8.neighbourhood: positives and matched negatives: 30 km / +-400 d ComCat (end capped at data pull); global_M5: ComCat global M>=4.5 +-0.5 yr
M8.primary_endpoint: false-positive rate, mode catalogue_only, on BOTH negative sets
M8.primary_criterion: upper 95% Clopper-Pearson bound < 0.02 for each negative set (conjunction; both must pass)
secondary_endpoints: recall per class on positives (both modes; all and M2-4.5 subset), Clopper-Pearson 95% CI, DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (approved 2026-10-11)
sensitivity: control exclusion 50 km instead of 25 km around case centres
M8.reporting: result reported regardless of outcome; no re-tuning of thresholds
M8.criterion_history: global_M5 criterion written 2026-10-11 before S2b (32e3159); matched-set criterion added 2026-10-11 before the matched S2b result was computed

not_tested: forcing coupling (Groningen: no forcing test; optional later manual NLOG export by J. Roemer; Koyna: catalogue-only negative case)
decisions_resolved_2026-10-11: Napoleonville 2012 and Kilauea 2018 added (S0 amendment A1)
